name: AltchaCaptcha
author: altered.wiki contributors
description: Self-hosted proof-of-work CAPTCHA using Altcha, with no external service dependency.

AltchaHmacKey.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret key used to sign and verify Altcha challenges. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

AltchaComplexityMin.description: Minimum number of SHA-256 iterations the client must perform.

AltchaComplexityMax.description: Maximum number of SHA-256 iterations the client must perform.

AltchaJSUrl.description: Upstream URL to fetch the Altcha widget JS from. Fetched server-side and cached locally; never loaded directly by the browser.

AltchaJSTTL.description: How long (in seconds) to serve the cached Altcha JS before re-fetching from upstream. Default: 86400 (24 hours).
